title: Settings
lead: Your anonymous ID, display preferences, vehicle and prices used for the analyses.

account.title: Your ID
account.note: You were given a random ID on your first visit. No name, no e-mail, no password.
account.localOnly: This site stores your trips only in this browser. Keep the ID and download a backup to move your data to another device.

vehicle.title: Vehicle
vehicle.note: The usable battery capacity of a new car is the 100 % reference for the battery health estimate.
vehicle.capacityHint: Approximate public figures; enter your own if you know better.

prices.title: Prices
prices.note: Used on the costs page. All prices per kWh charged.
prices.homeShareHint: Rough share of energy charged at home.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: Exports are read and analysed entirely in your browser and stored in its local database (IndexedDB). A single first-party cookie holds your anonymous ID; it is required for the site to work and is never used for tracking. There is no analytics and no advertising.
privacy.p2: The map loads tiles from OpenFreeMap only after you allow it on the map page; their servers then see your IP address.
privacy.p3: If a sync server is enabled (self-hosted Docker installation), your trips are stored there under a hash of your ID. Anyone who knows your ID can read these trips, so treat it like a password.
